mission.title: Why She Swallowed the Fly
mission.description: Find out what the wireframed men's code overrides are doing to the Merovingian's programs, then find out what Halborn wants.

npc.say: And the Merovingian still wants to use him...
They'll be avenged... No power that destructive survives for long.
I need to see her. That's all you need to know. Is your boss going to keep his promise, or isn't he?
Yeah, yeah, I heard about the cookies...
What he does when he meets her is not our affair, is it?
The Merv relies on us more than ever now that the wireframes are making things tough for programs. Doesn't seem like such a bad thing to me.
He ain't so tough. Hell, dude doesn't even know karate.

phase.briefing:
While the Merovingian would like to milk the two wireframed men, Halborn and Carlyne, for all they're worth, their mutual dislike, combined with their code overrides, is leading them to make a mess of things.
We've just lost touch with a pack of our programs, {player}. Informants have described what sounds like code overrides going off in their vicinity, so I expect the worst.

enter.say: Hm... I'm picking up some overridden code, but no really active programs in there.

done.say: Whoa... No sign of forced entry, but I'm reading recently spent shell casings in there, and there are bullet and claw wounds on the bodies. Could they have been fighting each other?

phase.briefing:
I *suppose* it's possible that one group was overridden by Carlyne, and one by Halborn, and they met at cross purposes, but really, operative, I don't care. One or the other of them--or both--just cost us four programs, and they're both likely to cost us more as long as they've got access to those override routines of theirs.
Case in point: I'm being pestered by another group of our programs. Apparently some of their number have been overridden, and are attacking those who weren't. Go try to salvage some of them, hm?

enter.say: I'm reading overrides in most of the programs in there, but I see one--wait, two--that are still running clean.
It was that big one! Halborn! He'd have got us, too, but he stopped all of a sudden and ran. Then the others turned on us!
Keep those two alive, would you, {player}? Get rid of the other ones.
Hah! Come on! We'll put a stop to this desecration!

near.say: There were more! Where are they?

phase.briefing:
It look like Halborn is indeed skulking around in that area, operative. It may also interest you to know that there's a rumor going around that he just met with the Machines again. I wouldn't be surprised if they've manipulated the simple-minded barbarian into taking out his frustrations on our programs...
I think it's about time we--that is, you, operative--had a talk with him. Hold his hand, look into his eyes, I don't care--just find out what the devil he thinks he's doing.

enter.say: If Flood's right, then the big override signal I've got in there is our beloved intruder. Guess this is where you, uh, work your magic.

talk.say:
Who invited you? Go take a--
... Wait. Do you... Hm. ... What do you know about the Oracle?

done.say: Ohh boy. Uh... You better tell him we're gonna check our sources and get right back to him. I think we need to run this by Flood.

phase.briefing:
Hm... An interesting development. You know the Merovingian's feelings on that particular subject. Mm... Just a moment.
...
Well, it seems the Merovingian would enjoy a chat about the Oracle with Halborn. He's getting chummier with that oaf than I'd advise, but, eh, it's his life.

enter.say: Flood's so cute when he pretends not to care--and then, of course, he sends us in so he can stay up on what's going on.

talk.say: Okay... So I'll start around that courtyard in Mara, then. What else? What kind of defenses does she have?

Bonjour. If there is anything about the Oracle that you would care to share with Halborn, please feel free. Many wait years to see her, after all... But our friend here does not seem to have that kind of time.

mission.finish:
Well, that's clear enough. He wants to see the Oracle, we help make it happen, and if either or both of them happen to kick off as a result, we'll make the most of it--and let's not forget this mysterious "biological interface program" he's after. He must think the Oracle has it... Hm...
Oh, go away, {player}. Can't you see I'm trying to get some serious work done here?
